major_events: Su Ming overcomes the four statues representing different clans (Barbarian, Immortal, Evil Spirit, Mishi) to clear the eighth layer of the Eastern Wastelands Tower. [第三卷 名震东荒 第706章 东荒塔第八层]

Su Ming experiences a profound epiphany regarding space and perception on the ninth layer of the Eastern Wastelands Tower, realizing the concept of '山河在心' (mountains and rivers exist in the heart/mind), which projects a blood-red light across the Eastern Wastelands. [第三卷 名震东荒 第708章 我的秋天！]
Su Ming awakens his Underworld ('冥') power and subdues the rebellious killing sword, converting its energy into a golden fingernail on his right index finger. [第三卷 名震东荒 第710章 出塔！]
Su Ming leads the Barbarians and the Life Clan (命族) to destroy the Daye Immortal Sect (大叶仙宗), slicing through their sacred mountain. [第三卷 名震东荒 第711章 灭宗！]
Su Ming rescues his Second Senior Brother (二师兄) from Daye Immortal Sect's core array, where he was chained and drained to provide spiritual energy to the sect. [第三卷 名震东荒 第713章 总有牺牲，总有贪生]
Su Ming reunites with his third senior brother Hu Zi (虎子) at the ruins of Daye mountain, where Hu Zi returns Second Senior Brother's secret stash. [第三卷 名震东荒 第726章 是谁的？]
Su Ming visits the Shaman God Island (巫神岛) in South Marsh (南泽) to act as a protector for the breakthrough of Shaman practitioners. [第三卷 名震东荒 第731章 巫神岛]
Su Ming clashes with cultivators from the Dao Morning Sect (道晨宗) like Dao Yuan (道原), forcing the activation of the Starry Sky Sacred Robe's three seals. [第三卷 名震东荒 第744章 三道封印！]
Su Ming's identity as the Son of Yin Death (阴死之子) is revealed, and he executes Dao Yuan before putting on a cold black mask to sever his emotional attachments. [第三卷 名震东荒 第748章 道原之死！]
Su Ming transitions to the Divine Source Waste Land (神源废地), landing on Huochi Star (火赤星) and breaking out of a powerful regional seal. [第四卷 崛起神源 第757章 破印而出！]
Su Ming acquires a mysterious treasure gourd (宝葫芦) and utilizes its power to slay his enemies, establishing his presence on Huochi Star. [第四卷 崛起神源 第777章 请宝葫芦杀人]
Su Ming defeats and kills Jing Nan Zi (京南子) through a combination of the gourd's power and the bald crane's trickery before departing Huochi Star. [第四卷 崛起神源 第787章 京南子，亡]
Su Ming fights through the West Ring (西环) nebula pursuers and declares his intent to make the name 'Mo Su' (墨苏) famous. [第四卷 崛起神源 第798章 我要此战扬名]
Su Ming achieves physical body sanctification (肉身成尊) within the restrictive seal of Shen Kong boundary (神空界). [第四卷 崛起神源 第809章 肉身成尊]
Su Ming is chased into a foreign land (异地) by the Zhao Family Ancestor (赵家老祖), where he refines the Ea Cangs (厄苍) clone. [第四卷 崛起神源 第829章 厄苍分身（一）]
Su Ming returns to Huochi Star, establishes himself as an elder of Yue Hongbang's clan, and encounters Shaman tribes in the Divine Source Waste Land. [第四卷 崛起神源 第865章 巫族再现]
Su Ming acts as the Fourth Generation Barbarian God (四代蛮神) to help Shaman tribes defeat their enemies and advances to the late World Realm (位界后期). [第四卷 崛起神源 第874章 位界后期]
Su Ming plots against Dao Kong (道空) from the Dao Morning Sect, successfully possesses him (夺舍道空), and creates a clone to infiltrate the Dao Morning Alliance. [第四卷 崛起神源 第906章 夺舍道空]

continuity_observations: Yu Xuan's sudden appearance in Chapter 721 as a long-term tracker feels retrofitted, as her presence in the Dead Sea battle was never hinted at in preceding chapters.

The transition from Book 3 to Book 4 at Chapter 750 maintains sequential chapter numbering rather than restarting from Chapter 1, preserving serialization continuity over volume division. [第四卷 崛起神源 第750章 神源废地]
A massive time skip of 100 years occurs in Chapter 789 with virtually no description of Su Ming's actions or mental progression during his drift in the cosmic void. [第四卷 崛起神源 第789章 百年]
The character Qian Chen (钱辰) completely drops out of the narrative as Su Ming enters the foreign land, leaving his status and fate unresolved.
The Shaman Great Priest's (大巫公) final reincarnation is altered from a 30-year-old man in Su Ming's memories to an 18-year-old youth, retroactively changing his peak physical form.

Tian Xie Zi's (天邪子) projection on the Shaman god image in Chapter 923 is introduced without explaining how he traveled from the Land of Yin Death to the Divine Source Star Sea. [第四卷 崛起神源 第923章 你的大巫公是谁！]
The surviving Daye Immortal Sect disciples are left in an ambiguous state; Su Ming spares them for resource reproduction, but the sect lands are forestified and the disciples vanish from the plot.

The Gourd's power limitations are bypassed; though it requires immense power to control and is capped at 20% for its creator, Su Ming uses it to slay Jing Nan Zi without clear explanations of his usage threshold. [第四卷 崛起神源 第777章 请宝葫芦杀人]
The Bald Crane's memory regarding Ea Cangs is inconsistent; it initially shows zero recognition of the tree, but suddenly recalls '岁尘子' and Ea Cangs in a state of high alarm.
style_observations: Use of the 'Life as a Picture Scroll' (画卷) metaphor to depict solemn, fatalistic narrative moments, such as Su Ming wearing the mask in the wind and snow. [第三卷 名震东荒 第749章 人生若只如初见]
Repetitive use of short rhetorical questions to build tension during breakthroughs or monologues (e.g., '是我的心，影响我的眼？', '是谁？在召唤吾').
Dramatic shifts between solemn philosophical reflections on mortality and lighthearted comedic relief involving the Bald Crane and the yellow dog. [第三卷 名震东荒 第721章 婚事……]
Omniscient narrator excursions that step outside the story to lecture on the natural order of life cycles (comparing seasons to birth, growth, blood, and death).
Progression markers characterized by massive numeric thresholds (e.g., '九万九千丈', '十万石碑') to depict power scaling. [第四卷 崛起神源 第825章 九万九千丈]
The signature comedic sidekick voice for the Bald Crane, utilizing recurring expressions like '他鹤奶奶的' and '鹤爷爷'.
originality_risks: The Treasure Gourd ('请宝葫芦杀人') closely mirrors the '斩仙飞刀' (Immortal Slaying Flying Dagger) from the classic Ming dynasty novel '封神演义' (Investiture of the Gods). [第四卷 崛起神源 第777章 请宝葫芦杀人]
The plot of using soul possession to steal a prestigious sect heir's identity and sell low-value items for huge profit is a highly conventional xianxia trope.
Eldest Senior Brother's transformation into a headless giant wielding an axe ('化身刑干，大斧在手') is a direct copy of the classic Chinese mythological figure Xing Tian (刑天). [第四卷 崛起神源 第923章 你的大巫公是谁！]
The 'greedy animal companion + lazy dog' comedic duo relies on standard comedy-relief templates from generic webnovels.
Reusing the three stages of perception ('看山是山，看山不是山，看山还是山') borrows directly from Er Gen's own previous novel '仙逆' (Renegade Immortal). [第三卷 名震东荒 第708章 我的秋天！]

creation_family_evidence.volume_boundary_marker: The text contains the explicit string '（本卷终）' at the end of Chapter 749, separating Book 3 (名震东荒) and Book 4 (崛起神源).
creation_family_evidence.proofread_version_indicators: The complete absence of standard serialization artifacts such as 'PS', '求推荐', or '求月票' indicates that this is a clean proofread compilation ('校对版全本').
creation_family_evidence.chapter_numbering_continuity: Chapter numbering remains continuous across the book transition, moving from Chapter 749 (第三卷 第749章) directly to Chapter 750 (第四卷 第750章) without resetting.
